Question: Each of \(20\) balls is tossed independently and at random into one of \(5\) bins. Let \(p\) be the probability that some bin ends up with \(3\) balls, another with \(5\) balls, and the other three with \(4\) balls each. Let \(q\) be the probability that every bin ends up with \(4\) balls. What is \(\dfrac{p}{q}?\)
